notes: Every signal is rank-normalised INSIDE its own source before fusion, so a venue with large raw magnitudes cannot outvote the others. Negative weights are penalties (paid placement, scanner risk); paid placement is always disclosed and never counts as demand. The same weights apply to every chain in chains.py.

volume_24h.rationale: Deepest cross-venue proof that real money is trading the pair today; volume is the hardest number to rent for 24h.

volume_accel.rationale: 6h volume annualised against the 24h rate separates a live move from a large incumbent that always trades.

liquidity.rationale: Exit-ability: thin pools manufacture volume ranks that nobody can actually sell into.

holder_growth.rationale: New holders per hour is organic distribution; airdrop or whale concentration does not produce it.

scanner_score.rationale: Our own risk-weighted scanner is the only signal no venue can sell, so it carries the largest single weight.

social_mentions.rationale: Narrative demand from the RAG corpus; capped low because shill campaigns inflate mentions cheaply.

bonding_progress.rationale: Launch-stage attention on GMGN bonding curves, scored low because it is pre-liquidity and venue-specific.

buy_pressure.rationale: Buy/sell trade ratio is the cheapest read on whether flow is one-sided demand or sell-side distribution.

growth.rationale: 24h trade count measures breadth of participation; a handful of wash trades cannot fake thousands of fills.

momentum_24h.rationale: Absolute 24h price change: attention follows volatility in BOTH directions, so dumps rank as loudly as pumps.

age.rationale: Fresh pairs carry discovery attention; weighted low because age alone is not demand and unknown age scores neutral.

risk_penalty.rationale: PENALTY: scanner risk score (0 safe - 100 rug) is subtracted so a fast-moving token with honeypot mechanics cannot outrank a clean one.

promotion_paid.rationale: PENALTY: paid placement is rented attention, not demand; negative weight plus a mandatory 'paid' label on every such evidence row.

paid_kinds.dexscreener_boost: DexScreener paid token boost (totalAmount is USD spent)

unwired_sources.gmgn: no stable public endpoint in this repo yet - holder_growth and bonding_progress are unavailable
unwired_sources.dextools: promo feed needs a paid API key - paid DexTools placements are not collected yet
unwired_sources.scanner: in-house scanner is not called from this path yet - scanner_score/risk_penalty unavailable
unwired_sources.social: corpus social_mentions only available when the RAG store is queried
